fields.name: author
fields.short: The ID for the author of the post

fields.name: categories
fields.short: The terms assigned to the post in the category taxonomy

fields.name: comment_status
fields.short: Whether or not comments are open on the post

fields.name: date
fields.short: The date the post was published, in the site's timezone

fields.name: date_gmt
fields.short: The date the post was published, as GMT

fields.name: featured_media
fields.short: The ID of the featured media for the post

fields.name: modified
fields.short: The date the post was last modified, in the site's timezone

fields.name: modified_gmt
fields.short: The date the post was last modified, as GMT

fields.name: ping_status
fields.short: Whether or not the post can be pinged

fields.name: slug
fields.short: An alphanumeric identifier for the post unique to its type

fields.name: status
fields.short: A named status for the post

fields.name: sticky
fields.short: Whether or not the post should be treated as sticky

fields.name: tags
fields.short: The terms assigned to the post in the post_tag taxonomy

fields.name: template
fields.short: The theme file to use to display the post

info.description: This API provides access to design-related quotes using the WordPress built-in REST API. It allows users to retrieve randomized quotes through a simplified request format, although it has limited features compared to previous versions. All other APIs have been discontinued, making this the primary source for quotes on design.
info.summary: This API provides access to design-related quotes using the WordPress built-in REST API.
info.title: Quotes on Design API
